info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Hotel Rooms Pricings-v5-spec
info.description: The Hotel Room Pricing API provides access to the pricing details of hotel rooms available in the system. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve comprehensive pricing information, including rates for various room types and seasonal pricing adjustments. It is primarily used by travel agencies, booking platforms, and hotel management systems to present accurate pricing to customers. The API helps streamline the process of checking room costs, enabling optimal pricing strategies and better decision-making for users in the hospitality industry.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the current pricing details for various rooms. It provides essential data that can be used for display or pricing calculations in client applications.
